# Druyn

> Druyn is a web application for visual project planning with an automatic, deterministic time forecast. Teams plan projects hierarchically as a process diagram, book working hours directly on tasks, and get a forecast that continuously respects dependencies, deadlines and team capacity. Made in Ennetmoos, Switzerland. German first; an English version of the app is in preparation.

Key facts: the forecast is deterministic (the same inputs always give the same result), Druyn is not a black-box AI and does not replace people. Three views: Planung (planning as a process diagram), Ausführung (booking hours on tasks in a weekly calendar), Prognose (schedule per role with milestones and free capacity in percent). Access is by invitation during the lighthouse phase.
